title: Professional Tax (Maharashtra)
summary: New companies in Maharashtra register for Professional Tax through SPICe+ (MCA FAQ 38). Other entities enrol (PTEC) and, as employers, register (PTRC) on MAHAGST.

authority.name: Department of Goods and Services Tax, Government of Maharashtra

sources.title: Enrolment Certificate (PTEC) under The Maharashtra State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1975
Certificate of Registration (PTRC) under The Maharashtra State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1975
FAQs on Incorporation and Allied Matters

steps.title: PTEC / PTRC through SPICe+
steps.description: For a new company in Maharashtra, Professional Tax registration (PTEC / PTRC) is done through the SPICe+ form (AGILE-PRO-S); no separate filing on MAHAGST.

fee.note: No separate filing; the SPICe+ consolidated challan lists form, MoA, AoA, PAN, TAN and URC-1 fees only (MCA FAQ 32).

review.note: Checked 2026-09-28, MCA FAQs Q38: "Registration for Profession Tax shall be mandatory through SPICe+ only in respect of new companies incorporated in the State of Maharashtra, Karnataka and West Bengal."

steps.title: Get the PT Enrolment Certificate (PTEC)
steps.description: PTEC lets the business pay Professional Tax for the entity and its professionals or owners. Create a profile on mahagst.gov.in, then New Registration under the PT Act (PTEC), Form II. Auto-approved; documents are not mandatory.

requirement.condition: Not a company (companies register through SPICe+)

forms.name: Application for a Certificate of Enrolment

documents.name: PAN (details from the Income Tax website accepted)
Latest electricity bill (proof of place of business and residence)

fee.note: No registration fee for applying under the Profession Tax Act.

officialSla.wording: Notified Timeline: 1 day (auto approval; RC generated within a day).

review.note: MAHAGST Trade Circular 01T of 2026 (14/03/2026) temporarily disabled PT registration on the portal; no official MAHAGST page yet says it is re-enabled (checked 2026-09-28).

steps.title: Get the PT Registration Certificate (PTRC)
steps.description: PTRC lets an employer deduct Professional Tax from employees' salary or wages and deposit it. New Registration under the PT Act (PTRC), Form I (Employers Registration Form). Auto-approved.

requirement.condition: Not a company, and the employer pays salary or wages

documents.name: PAN (details from the Income Tax website accepted)
Latest electricity bill (proof of place of business and residence)

fee.note: No registration fee for applying under the Profession Tax Act.

officialSla.wording: Notified Timeline: 1 day (auto approval; RC generated within a day).

review.note: MAHAGST Trade Circular 01T of 2026 (14/03/2026) temporarily disabled PT registration on the portal; no official MAHAGST page yet says it is re-enabled (checked 2026-09-28).
